await (async(page)=>{const results=[];for(const width of [375,1100,1200,1300]){await page.setViewportSize({width,height:812});const region=page.getByRole('region',{name:'수집 채널 스크롤',exact:true});await region.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();const before=await region.evaluate(e=>({client:e.clientWidth,scroll:e.scrollWidth}));const rows=[];for(const name of ['유튜브 브이로그','Threads','지식iN','82쿡']){const row=page.getByRole('row').filter({has:page.getByRole('switch',{name:name+' 사용하기',exact:true})});await row.locator('td').first().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();rows.push({name,visible:await row.isVisible(),text:await row.innerText()});if(width===375)await page.screenshot({path:page.qaDir+'QA-EDGE-003-settings-375-'+name+'.png'});}await page.screenshot({path:page.qaDir+'QA-EDGE-003-settings-'+width+'-left.png'});await region.evaluate(e=>e.scrollLeft=e.scrollWidth);await page.screenshot({path:page.qaDir+'QA-EDGE-003-settings-'+width+'-right.png'});results.push({width,document:await page.evaluate(()=>({inner:innerWidth,scroll:document.documentElement.scrollWidth})),before,after:await region.evaluate(e=>e.scrollLeft),rows});}return {time:new Date().toISOString(),url:page.url(),results};})(page);
